evidence_quotes: een watervergunning verleend voor een grondwateronttrekking
rationale: This Dutch Council of State (RvS) decision directly adjudicates a water permit (watervergunning) granted to Sachem for groundwater abstraction (grondwateronttrekking) in Zaltbommel. It squarely involves water resource regulation and permitting under Dutch water law, with no household utility connection refusal or informal settlement issue.
